ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ( (DATE(YEAR(Applicant2DateOfBirth__c ), MONTH( Applicant2DateOfBirth__c ), DAY(Applicant2DateOfBirth__c )) > DATE(YEAR(TODAY()) - 18, MONTH(TODAY()), DAY(TODAY()))) ), NOT(ISBLANK(Applicant2DateOfBirth__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Applicant 2 must be at least 18 years old at the time of application submission. Please select "Yes" for exception request in the administrative section and fill out the details under the "exception request" section.
